name: YATINEY 4-Tier Bakers Rack with Power Outlets
description: YATINEY 4-tier kitchen bakers rack and microwave stand in rustic brown. Features integrated power outlets with built-in circuit breaker protection for safely running kitchen appliances like coffee makers or blenders. Designed with multiple storage shelves and includes S-shaped hooks for hanging mugs or utensils. Sturdy metallic frame with rustic wood-toned shelves. Excellent for a space-saving coffee bar station or pantry organizer. Selling cheap for graduation moving sale! Note: Appliances and items on the rack are not included.
name_zh: YATINEY 4层带插座复古风厨房置物架
description_zh: YATINEY 4层美式复古风厨房置物架/微波炉架。带有集成电源插座，具备断路器保护功能，可安全为咖啡机、破壁机等厨房小家电供电。多层储物设计，附带S型挂钩方便悬挂杯子或厨具。金属铁框搭配复古棕色木板，稳固耐用，非常适合作为省空间的咖啡吧台或厨房收纳。毕业低价清仓！（照片中架子上的电器和杂物为非卖品，不包含在内）
